# Voice Flow

> Voice Flow is an anonymous school feedback platform. Students report
> problems, share ideas, and vote in polls with no names, no emails, and no
> tracking — and every report is tracked publicly from Reported to Solved.

Voice Flow lets students share anonymous feedback and report school issues
without revealing who they are. Posts move through a visible pipeline
(Reported → Verified → In Progress → Waiting → Solved), school staff moderate
and resolve them, and the whole school can see what actually changed. Each
student's only identifier is a random ID generated in their own browser —
there is no account, no email, and no IP logging against posts.

## Product

- [About](https://voice-box-psi.vercel.app/about): What Voice Flow is and how anonymity works
- [Frequently asked questions](https://voice-box-psi.vercel.app/faq): Anonymity, moderation, deleting posts, polls
- [Solving board](https://voice-box-psi.vercel.app/board): Issues moving through the fix pipeline
- [Polls](https://voice-box-psi.vercel.app/polls): School-wide polls with live results
- [Suggestions](https://voice-box-psi.vercel.app/suggestions): Ideas the school can vote on
- [Download](https://voice-box-psi.vercel.app/download): Android APK and Windows desktop app
